25.text: body who kills one may be sure of dying a violent death within a very short

30.text: The reˊkkeñ of the Kolyma country is quite different from the reˊkkeñ

31.text: of the Pacific. It is a bear-like monster with very large ears that catch even

32.text: the slight sound made by the wings of a mosquito flying by.

33.text: In a tale of the Kolyma Chukchee, two such reˊkkeñɪt are tied as door-

34.text: keepers to the entrance of the house of a keˊlᴇ. An incantation obtained in

35.text: the same part of the country mentions the advantage of using the large ears

36.text: of the reˊkkeñ for a tent, to protect the conjurer from evil spirits.

37.text: Kočaˊtko is a giant polar bear with a body of solid ivory (Fig. 232).

38.text: Sometimes he is said to have eight paws. He is much stronger and fiercer

39.text: than the ordinary polar bear. Mɪrg̣-uˊmkɪ (literally, “bald polar bear”)
